title: Japanese Crepes with Ginger Filling
description: Delicious crepes filled with a sweet and spicy ginger filling, perfect for a Japanese-inspired dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: French Crepes
ingredients.notes: Thaw crepes according to package instructions

instructions: In a small saucepan, combine ginger, bitter, sugar, and water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Strain the ginger mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl, pressing on the solids to extract as much liquid as possible. Discard the solids.
Add yuzu juice to the ginger mixture and stir to combine.
Lay a crepe flat on a work surface. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the ginger mixture onto the center of the crepe.
Fold the crepe in half over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the crepe into a tight cylinder.
Serve the crepes warm or at room temperature.
Repeat with remaining crepes and filling.
Garnish with additional yuzu juice and grated ginger, if desired.
